written: before any R8.12 Qortuba run; committed with the frozen WALL_BAND_POLICY_V3
1_whole_face_pairing: Mostly, but it is TWO limitations: (a) mutual nearest over the whole face - H477 has two equally near partners (H470, H471) and the tie goes to H470; (b) the H470 / H477 strip is crossed by column H718, and V2 rejects the WHOLE band for any crossing. Fixing (a) alone does not establish H2430.
2_local_model_correct: Yes, but local pairing alone also fixes the wrong thing silently: end classification and the closure purity test need to know that H470 and H471 are ONE face. Local spans need strict face chains next to them.
3_model: C - both: strict FACE CHAINS (numeric contiguity, typed nodes) for end classification, purity and provenance; LOCAL INTERVAL PAIRING (local mutual nearest per elementary interval) for spans; crossings SUBDIVIDE a strip (obstacle overlap / node) instead of rejecting it.
4_unsafe_failure_mode: Local pairing turns an unlabelled SLICE of a room into a band: a room's floor and ceiling walls are locally mutual nearest wherever nothing lies between them. Also: chains joined by near-collinearity or the 50 mm review band, and the strip between two column sides read as an empty band.
5_openings_not_merged: Fragments join only when their end points coincide within eps_n (numeric equivalence, ~0.001 mm here) on the same supporting line, the same occurrence and with no opening / glazing segment ending at the joint. Any real gap breaks the chain; the 50 mm review band is never continuity.

6_chain_stops.window_opening: gap or glazing at the joint -> OPENING_BREAK
6_chain_stops.drafting_gap: break (only a topology closure may bridge it, never a chain)
6_chain_stops.t_junction: NODE - the face continues (subdivision, not an end)
6_chain_stops.crossing_wall: the strip interval becomes CROSSING_WALL_NODE; the face chain is not cut
6_chain_stops.column: the strip interval becomes OBSTACLE_OVERLAP; neighbouring intervals stay spans

7_blind_possible: Yes: every fixture is a generic case (fragment pairs, gaps, openings, T-junctions, columns, duplicates, orientation, re-segmentation) frozen before the Qortuba run.
8_disagree_with_prompt: 'chain break at T_JUNCTION' would break H470 / H471 exactly at the 7117 junction - a T-junction must be a node
elongation must stay on the raw CHAIN overlap, never per span (a short span beside a column would fail)
band / closure ids change with the policy version; regressions must compare geometry, not ids
9_new_risk: If the H2430 closure is authorised, the H2430 role conflict disappears and the ONLY Q-13 issue left may be the floor object-footprint rule (SF3 / FIRNTUR are material to the floor only through it): the sole-blocker test must be a counterfactual over both answers, not a scan of blocker labels.
10_after_r8_12: R8.13: the DWG <-> DXF source anchor (the release blocker on every new-revision row), the REVIEWED closure release level as a signed record, then the one owner floor question if it is the sole Q-13 blocker; move the row / release digests and owner physical facts fully into engine provenance.
